rows.text: The key to piloting Noctis, Prince of Lucis is understanding its core engine: Noctis allows you to cast artifact spells directly from your graveyard by paying 3 life. His built-in lifelink recoups that life instantly on combat, enabling rapid recovery of sacrifice engines, baubles, and artifact win conditions.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe, Demonic Tutor. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
